google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.compute_fid_between_sentences: compute the FID between generated and real sentences using the universal sentence encoder
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.run_fid_evaluation: run the fid function to measure frechet distance between two lists of sentences

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.train_scratchgan: train a ScratchGAN model with LSTM generator and discriminator on a text dataset

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.build_sequential_cross_entropy_loss: build a TensorFlow module that computes sigmoid cross entropy loss for sequential binary classification logits

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.test_sequential_cross_entropy_loss: test the sequential cross entropy loss function with batched logits and expected label tensors

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.build_vocabulary: build a word-to-ID vocabulary from JSON data sorted by token frequency using the internal _build_vocab function

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.append_position_signal: append position signal embeddings to a batch of word embeddings tensor
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.create_length_mask: create a boolean mask tensor from a batch of sequence lengths and max length
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/scratc.find_first_occurrence: find the index after the first occurrence of a symbol in each row of a tensor
